avis.texte: My acne becomes a problem during the summer and i wear face makeup almost everyday. This is the one product that helped the most. I double cleanse at night and i dont combine with any other acne treatments. The bottle lasts a long time even with everyday use and I've repurchased several times. However, I don't notice a difference in blackheads so I would recommend trying something else if thats what your problem is.

I like the product and it combines a lot of different active ingredients (AHA,BHA, Lactic Acid) into one so it's a value. I was confused on how to use the product because it's designed like a spot treatment, but also says its "full face" and to "apply to the entire area". Its to be used "at night", but also "1-3 times daily"? Am I waking up to reapply? Not to be naive, it was a little confusing. It's powerful stuff, so use a little bit and increase until it's effective. I had a breakout and peeling, but after purging, things have cooled off and hoping to see clear skin in the next couple weeks. I add a couple drops to my moisturizer so it can spread around.
